description: This source file provides functions to generate build entries for bundled plugins, collect plugin source files, list build artifacts, and manage runtime dependencies for a plugin system. It interacts with the filesystem to read plugin directories, manifest files, package.json files, and filters files based on extensions and naming conventions.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a package.json file from a given path, returning null if the file does not exist or cannot be parsed.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its package name and surface entries.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Collects source file entries defined within the plugin's openclaw extension list or defaults to './index.ts'.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Checks whether runtime dependencies should be staged based on package JSON options.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Lists public surface files (like .ts, .js, etc.) in the plugin directory, excluding test and definition files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Gathers build entries for all plugins in the BUNDLED_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR, filtering based on manifest presence and other conditions.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Creates a mapping from build entry names to filesystem paths for plugin source files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists all artifacts (JSON, package, JS files) needed for plugin packaging.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of runtime dependencies for plugins that require them.
